headline: Crumbling Infrastructure Threatens R2.5 Billion Industrial Investment in South Africa
summary: Manufacturers in South Africa's Wadeville hub warned that deteriorating municipal services in Ekurhuleni endanger R2.5 billion in existing and planned investments, prompting business relocations.
why: Ekurhuleni is a primary manufacturing hub in South Africa, contributing significantly to national industrial economic output.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Infrastructure failures in key industrial districts threaten manufacturing output and corporate investment.
